# The snapshots the selftest cannot hold still (docs/40-testing.md §2):
# what the status bar held still and the masks of shell/snapcmp.go do not
# cover. One per line, "<name> <verb> [<regexp>]", <name> a glob:
#   skip          not compared
#   skip-text     the text renderer's not compared
#   skip-pixel    the pixel renderer's not compared
#   mask <re>     each match (its first group if it has one) shown as "#",
#                 before the pixel renderer lays the text out
# A line that names no snapshot of the script fails the shell tests.

# The simulated weather follows the date.
41-weather skip
41-location-dialog skip
41-location-always skip
78-charging mask \S+ \S+ -?\d+°[CF]
92-idle-es mask \S+ \S+ -?\d+°[CF]
93-nfc-pick mask \S+ \S+ -?\d+°[CF]
# Behind a dialog: only the pixel renderer draws the standby screen there.
70-usb-trust mask \S+ \S+ -?\d+°[CF]
93-nfc-present mask \S+ \S+ -?\d+°[CF]

# The month and the day of the run, with their lunar dates and holidays.
60-calendar-month skip
61-calendar-day skip

# Today's date in the settings.
92-datetime-es mask \p{L}+, \d{1,2} de \p{L}+

# Timings measured in the run.
50-native-compare skip

# Behind the dialog, the contacts case's call to 13700001234: hung up as
# soon as it connects, it lasted 0 s (no duration shown) or 1 s, as the
# second turned.
47-sim-pin mask ^已拨(?: · \d\d:\d\d)?$

# The computer's kernel, and how long the Shell has run (with the spaces
# before them: the values are right-aligned).
40-about mask [ ]*\d+\.\d+\.\d+[-\w.+]*
40-about mask [ ]*(?:\d+h)?(?:\d+m)?\d+s\b

# The video plays on (2 to 4 seconds in) while it is taken: how far the
# bar is, and in pixels the picture.
52-video mask [━─]{3,}
52-video skip-pixel

# The song plays on (3 to 9 seconds in): how far the bar is.
27-music mask [━─]{3,}
27-music skip-pixel

# The voice message records on: how far its bar is, drawn and not text.
32-voice-rec skip-pixel

# The simulated camera is a live picture: in the video call's corner and
# in the viewfinder (its photos are one picture, phone-mediad --test-stills).
05-video-call skip-pixel
34-camera skip-pixel

# The wallet numbers an order by the time it was made; the wide screen
# shows it beside the confirmation.
10-trusted-confirm mask P(\d{10,})
76-pay-fingerprint mask P(\d{10,})
77-pay-invalidated mask P(\d{10,})

# A push token made for the run: base64url, its data and its signature
# (the text renderer cuts it short).
53-tutorial-reminder mask [A-Za-z0-9_-]{12,}(?:\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]*)?

# The family pairing code is random, and so its QR code.
96-parent-code mask \d{4} \d{4}
96-parent-code skip-pixel

# The text renderer wraps the article's address inside its port.
04-permission mask (\d{4})/article

# How long ago the account last synced.
accounts mask (\d+ \S+前)
